name: scholialang
description: Scholialang plugin 0.7.2: local reasoning DAG and stable Scholia v0.6.2 grammar validation for Claude Desktop.
long_description: Scholialang plugin release 0.7.2 gives Claude Desktop an explicit, local evidence graph for goals, hypotheses, observations, evidence, findings, decisions, actions, contradictions, and conclusions. It implements the stable Scholia v0.6.2 language grammar. Traces are stored in a local SQLite database under the user's home directory. The extension makes no network calls and requires no account or API key.

tools.name: scholia_dag_ensure_session
tools.description: Open or resume a local per-project Scholialang session DAG.

tools.name: scholia_dag_add_atom
tools.description: Record an explicit reasoning atom and its evidence relationships.

tools.name: scholia_dag_summary
tools.description: Return a compact summary of a local Scholialang DAG.

tools.name: scholia_dag_search
tools.description: Search local Scholialang traces and decisions.

tools.name: scholia_lint_snippet
tools.description: Validate a Scholia snippet against the stable Scholia v0.6.2 language grammar.
